description: This source file defines the RevokeAuthenticationEvents class, which extends CookieAuthenticationEvents to handle validation of user principal cookies in an ASP.NET Core web application. It checks a cache to determine if user access has been revoked and signs out the user if so.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: Custom implementation of CookieAuthenticationEvents to revoke user sessions based on cache entries.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Overrides the base method to check if the user's session has been revoked and signs out the user accordingly.
